faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PRMMCH Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PRMMCH Medical Officer recruitment is 08 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Medical Officer position is a minimum of 25 years and a maximum of 70 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the PRMMCH Medical Officer job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Medical Officer post in this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contractual job position.

faq.answer: The official notification was released on 24 July 2026.
